grok43_addendum.harness_note: Run via a standalone script (/tmp scratchpad, not committed) that mirrors evals/dbattery/judge-backtest.mjs's method EXACTLY -- same RUBRIC text, same blind A/B re-presentation in the archived order, same both-orders-agree/TIE_FLIP house rule, same Wilson 95% CI -- rather than editing judge-backtest.mjs, because this task's file grant covers only judges.json. judge-backtest.mjs itself is unmodified.
deployment_quirks: grok-4.3 is a REASONING model by default on this deployment (unlike grok-4-20-non-reasoning): with no reasoning_effort set it burns hidden reasoning_tokens (measured 593-738 on a trivial 2-line probe, 4.5s latency) even though the visible completion is unaffected -- confirmed NOT a truncation/empty-response failure (xAI deployments cap only visible output on max_tokens per context/measurements.md `reasoning-split`), but a latency/cost cost if left unset.
reasoning_effort:'none' (same enum value already used for gpt-5.6-terra) eliminates it: 0 reasoning_tokens, ~0.5s latency, identical visible-answer shape. Used throughout this backtest.

Unlike terra, grok-4.3 takes the plain xAI-style `max_tokens` param (NOT `max_completion_tokens`) and accepts temperature:0 without complaint -- confirmed live, all three params (max_tokens, temperature:0, reasoning_effort:'none') combined in one call, 200 OK.
grok43_addendum.structural_caveat: grok-4.3 is xAI-family. charm-grok's candidate arm is grok-4-20-non-reasoning, also xAI-family -- a judge-family conflict on that half only. charm-luna's candidate (openai/gpt-5.6-luna) has no such conflict. Both archives were run; agreement is reported per-archive AND pooled so the conflicted half cannot hide inside a pooled number.

family_conflict_analysis.note: favoritism defined measurably as: grok-4.3's fresh per-unit pick-rate for the archive's candidate arm, vs the ARCHIVED ground-truth pick-rate for that same arm (baseline). charm-grok's baseline is context/measurements.md `judge-backtest` line 1's own 38-2 pooled figure (incumbent-grok), i.e. grok won only 2/40 non-tie archived units (5%).

verdict_summary.overall: FAIL -- fails pooled AND on both individual archives, including charm-luna where no family conflict exists. Not PASS-WITH-SCOPE: a 'qualified for non-grok comparisons only' verdict would require charm-luna alone to clear 80%, and it does not (54.2%, CI [40.3,67.4]).
